calls.title: Jul 16, 09:35 AM
calls.summary: The team discussed a hybrid approach for managing projects and feature flags, proposed by Vicson Victor, which combines shared and platform-specific needs to enhance efficiency. Chris Sanders highlighted the importance of payload efficiency and avoiding data leakage by minimizing unnecessary flags. They clarified that SDK connections manage feature flags based on projects, allowing for granular control across different platforms. Challenges were acknowledged regarding environment management in the marketplace, where multiple environments require strategic SDK connection management. The team also examined the merging of feature flags and experiments within Growth Book and emphasized a phased rollout planned for mid-August, along with detailed training sessions for seamless integration.
calls.keywords: Growth Book, feature flags, SDK connections, environments, experiments, project management
